summary: Solution review found the delivered source covers the Left menu 4 requirements: Level 1 items are Home, Feedback, and Configure; Feedback replaces Feedback Request; Feedback and Configure are button-based expandable parents; Home remains a direct dashboard link; submenu routes render matching headings; Provide Feedback preserves the existing upload workflow. Review checks passed: `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`, `npm.cmd run lint`, focused dashboard source test 4/4, and full Node unit suite 28/28. Browser execution was not run in this sandbox. Recorded controller Playwright reports passed, but they only executed `feedback/registration.spec.ts`, so they do not provide executed browser coverage for the new left-menu interaction.

defects.description: The intake requires interactive menu behavior, but there is no executed functional/browser spec for Left menu 4. `.ai_factory/tests/functional/dashboard/left-menu-4-test-design.md` is design-only, `.ai_factory/tests/functional` contains only `feedback/registration.spec.ts` as an executable spec, and both controller Playwright reports show only the registration spec executed. Source/static tests cover labels, routes, and code patterns, but they do not exercise expanding/collapsing Feedback or Configure, preserving main content on parent clicks, or navigating submenu items in a browser.
